Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Elmore Pillow-Top Armless Accent Chair, 24"W, Beige
Colors: Beige
Materials: stone
This armless pillow-top chair will add comfort and elegance to any modern or classic style space. Assembled in the U.S., it features a sturdy wood frame, reversible seat and back cushions. Metal casters on the solid wood legs make it easy to move. This item is made to order just for you 24"W x 33"D x 35"H Sturdy wood frame and legs; 100% cotton fabric. A transitional piece that will blend with most any décor Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Assemble in 15 minutes or less. Vacuum or wipe with a soft, dry cloth.
